configurePresets.name: ecs3d-debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build with assertions live. What CI exercises alongside release, and the configuration the check target is normally run under. Writes to cmake-build-debug.

configurePresets.name: ecs3d-release
configurePresets.description: Optimized build. The configuration the engine is run and profiled in, and the second build type CI covers. Writes to cmake-build-release.

configurePresets.name: ecs3d-sanitize
configurePresets.description: Debug plus AddressSanitizer, and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer where the toolchain has it (Clang and GCC; MSVC ships ASan only). Aimed at the headless test suite; see the README for why the apps are a different matter. Writes to cmake-build-sanitize.
